en.title: Bribery and interference scandal in courthouse: 5 judicial officials suspended, former judge arrested
en.summary: An investigation into bribery and organized interference by the Bakırköy Chief Public Prosecutor's Office resulted in eight arrests, including a former judge. A portion of the case involving an opposition party lawmaker was referred to Ankara authorities.

en.title: Body found at lakeside identified as missing medical student after 10 days

en.title: Body found at lakeside identified as medical student missing for 10 days
en.summary: The remains found on a lakeshore in Eğirdir, Isparta have been confirmed to belong to 24-year-old medical student Ramazan Çin, who had been missing for ten days. An autopsy will determine the exact cause of death.
